versions.changelog:
Initial release of postking-seo skill.

- Enables full SEO/GEO content pipeline: from seed keywords to published, AI-citation-friendly articles using PostKing.
- Supports keyword expansion, clustering, roadmap/topic generation, brief drafting/editing, SEO/GEO-structured article writing, and publishing.
- Optimizes articles for both classic SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to increase likelihood of AI-generated citations.
- Includes key tools for gap analysis, competitor content comparison, and side/comparison page generation.
- Requires PostKing credits and an onboarded brand to use; integrates with other PostKing skills for advanced workflows.
